## Validation

Use blocked rolling-origin validation, never random shuffling. Report:

- Distributional MAE/RMSE on category proportions
- Multinomial log loss or negative log likelihood
- Calibration error and reliability curves
- Interval coverage and sharpness
- Baseline-relative improvement with confidence intervals

## Sensitivity and Robustness

Vary temporal window length, regularization strength, Dirichlet concentration, treatment of near-100% sums, missing-value rules, and denominator weighting. Compare models with and without puzzle-level features. Test stability across early, middle, and late chronological periods.

## Falsification

A proposed feature is rejected if it fails a blocked out-of-time comparison against the baselines, loses significance under date-preserving permutation, or produces residual autocorrelation and systematic calibration failure. Any apparent improvement relying on future aggregates is invalid.

## Reviewer Risks

Main risks are malformed merged headers, unknown denominators, compositional violations, temporal leakage, nonstationary player behavior, selective reporting, overfitting to a short daily series, and evaluating probabilities with an inappropriate point-error metric. Exact subquestion coverage must be checked once the full statement is available.
